subject: E-Commerce
title: User-Generated Content Sells
description: A fast breakdown of User-Generated Content Sells for builders.

hook.text: Customer photos convert 5x better than professional product photos. Imperfect images feel more honest.

buildup.text: Professional photos look polished but feel staged. Real photos show how products look in actual homes and lives.

discovery.text: Brands now ask buyers to share photos and videos. This 'UGC' is free marketing that converts better than ads.

twist.text: Some brands pay people to create 'user-generated' content that looks authentic. Manufactured authenticity is a genre.

climax.text: Real customer content is the most trusted form of marketing. Authenticity sells better than perfection.

punchline.text: 5x more conversions from customer photos. Real beats polished in e-commerce.

quiz.question: Why do customer photos convert better than professional product photos?
options: They feel more honest and show products in real-world contexts
